strips.title: There Is No Opting Out
strips.headline: Google says there’s no way to use Search without using artificial intelligence

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: Every search is AI now. You can’t even opt out!

panels.speaker: Pinocchio
panels.line: It also answered your question before you asked it. Twice.

panels.speaker: Gandalf
panels.line: You shall not pass that answer without a source link.
